ops.title: Apple-side setup for a new signed helper app — ASC API first
ops.description: One-time Apple portal work (team SXKCTF23Q2) before a repo's first release-app.yml signed release: explicit App IDs, App Groups capability, and Developer ID provisioning profiles whose names byte-match the repo's project.yml PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER + the workflow's profile_names. Do it via the App Store Connect API — proven 2026-07-19 for captain-hook; browser automation is unnecessary and was blocked by cookiesync headless-auth (cookie-sync investigation 26d39fe). Never revoke existing certs (cap of 5); only ADD; xcodebuild -allowProvisioningUpdates FETCHES these by name at build time, it cannot create them.

ops.text: Creds: op read op://OpenClaw/ASC_ADMIN_KEY_CC_PRESENT/credential | base64 -d > key.p8 (0600, delete after); key id from the item's 'key id' field; issuer = MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID. The notary key trio READS provisioning but 403s on writes
JWT ES256 (pyjwt): {iss: issuer, iat: now, exp: now+600, aud: 'appstoreconnect-v1'}, header kid=<key id>; Bearer against https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com/v1

Find the signing cert: GET /certificates?filter[certificateType]=DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION,DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION_G2 — this team's cert is the G2 type; a plain DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION filter returns empty
Per bundle: POST /bundleIds {identifier, name, platform: MAC_OS} (GET first — idempotent re-runs reuse the existing id)

Per bundle: POST /bundleIdCapabilities {capabilityType: APP_GROUPS, relationships.bundleId} — yields the SXKCTF23Q2.* app-groups authorization; no group registration step exists or is needed for TeamID-prefixed macOS groups

Per bundle: POST /profiles {name: <byte-exact frozen name>, profileType: MAC_APP_DIRECT, relationships: bundleId + certificates:[cert id]}; decode attributes.profileContent (base64) to a .provisionprofile
Verify each: security cms -D -i <file> — assert Name exact, TeamIdentifier SXKCTF23Q2, Platform OSX, com.apple.security.application-groups covers the repo's group
Secrets if absent: set-release-secrets.sh <owner/repo> (repo-bootstrap skill); gh secret list shows 6
If a release already failed on 'No profile ... found': gh run rerun <id> --failed re-runs the helper leg and its skipped cask dependent; preflight outputs persist
